editorial.name: Cognito
editorial.descriptionZh: Cognito 做身份验证与 KYC/AML：Flow 一次做完证件与自拍核验并管流程，Screening 查全球观察名单与 PEP，Identity 则从手机号开始做轻量核验。首屏用一圈浮动的 Selfie、ID Doc、Address、Fraud 图标绕着人像说明它核什么。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看合规产品怎么把风控环节画成一圈图标
editorial.noteZh: 顶部一条黑底公告写 Check out our newest products, Plaid Identity Verification and Monitor，说明它已经并入 Plaid。首屏主标 There's a better way to verify your customers，其中 verify 一词用紫到蓝的渐变，副标 Smarter identity verification services and compliance solutions from Cognito，按钮是 Sign up 与 Request a demo；主视觉是一圈虚线圈，圆心是一个人像加意大利国旗的小圆，外围四个浮动标签写 Selfie、ID Doc、Address、Fraud。正文把产品分三条线：Flow 一节讲 International ID verification、Workflow management、ID doc and selfie check，Screening 一节讲 Global watchlist and PEP screening、Smart false-positive reduction、Scaleable ongoing monitoring，Identity 一节讲从手机号开始、Simple API integration、Industry-leading match rates。数字上有 < 60 sec average completion time、98% US pass rate、93% RoW pass rate，导航另挂 Address Verification、Age Verification、PEP Screening 等用例页。

reasons.statement: 首页从头到尾在卖 Cognito 自家的身份核验产品——三条产品线、通过率数字与用例页都指向它自己，按产品与公司官网归档；条目由 saaslandingpage.com 的落地页灵感收录。
